listing.name: MechAssault 2: Lone Wolf — MechAssault2 Recomp (LegendaryXP)
listing.summary: The project describes native input and widescreen features and maintainer gameplay tests. It does not claim a completed campaign. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox disc as ISO, XISO or an extracted folder containing ma2.xbe. The reviewed README does not specify the exact supported revision or hash; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run ma2.exe to import your game data and create a native build locally. Quiver is an optional launcher. For a source build, follow the project’s VS2022, CMake, Python capstone and xboxrecomp instructions.

warnings: The project describes native input and widescreen features and maintainer gameplay tests. It does not claim a completed campaign.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
